instructions.title: NutriFAQ-Chat update instructions
instructions.downloadDescription: Use this section to prepare the knowledge base content before integrating it into NutriFAQ-Chat.
instructions.downloadItem1: Drag and drop a file or select it with the Choose file button.
instructions.downloadItem2: Index the database to turn files into data the system can search and retrieve.
instructions.downloadItem3: This step lets the chatbot find the right content during responses and improves result accuracy.
instructions.supportNote: Need help? Write to us at info@imxtech.ca
instructions.testDescription: Once the files are uploaded and indexed, switch to Validate mode to verify the real behavior.
instructions.testItem1: Ask a test question related to the indexed content.
instructions.testItem2: Verify that the response is correct and consistent.
instructions.testItem3: Check the formatting quality, context, and model-generated responses.
instructions.testItem4: Try different AI models to compare response quality and relevance.
instructions.publishDescription: When the result is satisfactory, use the Publish section to finalize production.
instructions.publishItem1: Confirm the selected AI model before publishing.
instructions.publishItem2: Publish it. It may take some time.
instructions.publishItem3: If you are not satisfied or made a mistake, you can revert to the previous version.
instructions.publishItem4: Export the logs if you need to archive or analyze the interactions.

legal.title: ⚠️ Important warnings
content: These virtual assistants are artificial intelligences offering general information for educational purposes, based on non-personalized content.
❌ DOES NOT REPLACE a medical or nutritional consultation
❌ DOES NOT DIAGNOSE
❌ DOES NOT PRESCRIBE treatment or nutrition plan
For any health problem:
✅ Consult a qualified healthcare or nutrition professional
✅ Never modify a treatment or care plan without professional advice
✅ In case of emergency, contact emergency services
The information provided is for educational purposes only and does not constitute a professional act.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
content: Your privacy is important to us. This privacy policy explains what data is collected, how it is used and protected when you use the IMX Agent assistant.
1. Data collected
- Provided information: The questions you ask the assistant and the information you enter.
- Technical data: Information about the device, browser, IP address and connection data.
2. Use of data
- Provide and improve the AI assistant service.
- Ensure security and prevent abuse.
- Analyze application usage to improve user experience.
3. Data sharing
Your data is never sold to third parties. It may be shared only in the following cases:
- Compliance with legal obligations.
- Protection against fraud or security threats.
4. Security
We implement security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, modification or disclosure.
5. Your rights
- Access your personal data.
- Request correction or deletion of your data.
- Withdraw your consent at any time.
6. Contact
For any questions regarding this privacy policy, contact us at info@imxtech.ca.

about.title: About the application
content: This application is developed by IMX Technologie inc., a company specializing in the development of innovative artificial intelligence solutions.
Our tools aim to democratize access to AI technologies while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and privacy.
Each application is designed to provide an intuitive user experience and reliable results, tailored to the specific needs of our users.
To learn more about our projects and services, contact us at info@imxtech.ca.
